responsibility: Provides parser test utilities and regression tests for parsing source strings, token streams, diagnostics, lookahead/debug output, module parsing behavior, and whitespace-insensitive pretty-print comparisons.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `parser/tokenstream/tests.rs`, which exercises token-stream data structure behavior, and `parser/mut_visit/tests.rs`, which checks post-parse AST mutation, this file is the broad parser test hub with parse helpers and end-to-end parsing/diagnostic regressions.
